examples.purpose: Adding a bank account: people type part of their bank’s name and pick it, then press Continue. The screen checks that a bank was picked; errorMessage shows only once it sets isInvalid, as in the error state.
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <Card.Title>Add a bank account</Card.Title>
  <SuggestiveSearch
    label="Bank name"
    placeholder="Search bank name"
    items={['HDFC Bank', 'Himachal Pradesh Gramin Bank', 'ICICI Bank', 'State Bank of India', 'Axis Bank', 'Kotak Mahindra Bank', 'Punjab National Bank', 'Bank of Baroda', 'Canara Bank', 'Union Bank of India', 'IndusInd Bank', 'Yes Bank']}
    emptyMessage="No matching banks"
    errorMessage="Choose your bank from the list."
    onValueChange={() => {}}
  />
  <Button label="Continue" onPress={() => {}} />
</Card>

from.quote: Continue checks that a bank was picked from the list and shows an error if not

examples.purpose: The error state: the typed bank is not in the list, so the field is red and the message says how to fix the pick.

  isInvalid
  errorMessage="Choose your bank from the list."
/>

examples.purpose: Object items with an option that can’t be chosen: Ananya Iyer stays listed but disabled, such as a payee still being verified.

<SuggestiveSearch
  label="Beneficiary"
  placeholder="Search beneficiary"
  items={[
    { value: 'u1', label: 'Aarav Sharma' },
    { value: 'u2', label: 'Aditi Verma' },
    { value: 'u3', label: 'Rohan Mehta' },
    { value: 'u4', label: 'Ananya Iyer', disabled: true },
  ]}
  onValueChange={() => {}}
/>

props.name: label
props.description: Label rendered above the input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when the query is empty. Default "Search", from the component source.

props.name: items
props.description: The screen owns the items and any loading; the component filters, caps, highlights the first match in bold, and shows a check on the selected row. An option object may set disabled: it stays listed and can't be chosen. Declared: Suggestions to filter against the current query. May be bare strings or `{ value, label }` objects.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Current query text (controlled). When `undefined` the component manages its own query state internally.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: Initial query text for uncontrolled mode. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: onInputChange
props.description: Called whenever the query text changes (typing or selection).

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected suggestion value (controlled). When `undefined` the component tracks the selection internally.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selected value for uncontrolled mode. Default null, from the component source.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Choosing an option sets the query to its label and closes the list; typing anything else clears the selection. Declared: Called when a suggestion is chosen.

props.name: filter
props.description: Since c8526ae the default and custom filters get the trimmed query (“HDF ” lists HDFC Bank). Declared: Custom predicate deciding whether an option matches the current query. Defaults to a case-insensitive substring match on the label.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Minimum number of characters required before suggestions are shown. Default 1, from the component source.

props.name: maxResults
props.description: Caps the number of suggestions rendered. Defaults to no limit.

props.name: highlightMatch
props.description: Highlights the matched substring of each suggestion in bold. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown when the query has matched no suggestions. When omitted, the dropdown simply stays hidden on an empty result set.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Custom renderer for a suggestion row (overrides the default label).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the suggestion dropdown.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: On the web an uncontrolled list closes on any mousedown outside it, as designed; the guide's static examples pass the controlled open prop to keep their lists open. Declared: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

props.name: menuMaxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the suggestion list before it becomes scrollable. Default 240, from the component source.

props.name: menuOffset
props.description: Vertical gap between the input and the suggestion dropdown. Default 6, from the component source.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: The red asterisk is visible text; screen readers get the requirement from the field (aria-required on the web). Declared: Renders a required asterisk next to the label. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables interaction and dims the field. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field as invalid and shows `errorMessage`. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Renders the field as read-only (non-interactive, not dimmed). Default false, from the component source.

props.name: supportText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the input.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Replaces `supportText` when `isInvalid` is true.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes for design token resolution.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the outermost wrapper.

props.name: inputStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the input row.

props.name: inputTextStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the input text.

props.name: menuStyle
props.description: Style overrides for the suggestion dropdown container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label. Defaults to the visible label / placeholder.

props.name: accessibilityHint
props.description: Accessibility hint.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses focus.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier.

props.name: SuggestiveSearchItem.toString
props.description: Returns a string representation of a string. A field of each items row.

props.name: SuggestiveSearchItem.valueOf
props.description: Returns the primitive value of the specified object. A field of each items row.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection SuggestiveSearch reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Dropdown Item State
modes.description: A token collection SuggestiveSearch reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: FormField States
modes.description: Forced by the component from its props and focus: invalid gives Error, read only or disabled give Read Only (disabled adds 50 % opacity), focused gives Active, otherwise Idle. Declared: A token collection SuggestiveSearch reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Status
modes.description: A token collection SuggestiveSearch reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

slots.name: items
slots.description: A structured slot: an array of SuggestiveSearchItem rows. Suggestions to filter against the current query. May be bare strings or `{ value, label }` objects.

slots.name: renderItem
slots.description: Custom renderer for a suggestion row (overrides the default label).

events.description: Called whenever the query text changes (typing or selection).

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen.

events.description: Called whenever the open state changes.

gaps.text: Suggestive Search still differs from Figma (raised in #233, not claimed by its fix): it bolds the typed text where Figma greys it, its placeholder colour (#888a8d) differs, it marks the chosen row with a grey fill and a 16 px check (Figma: white with a 20 px check), and its rows are 44 px (Figma: 43 px).
